comments.author: Alrn
comments.body:
The English name of this item is "Shining Heliolite". Obtained from any legacy discovery of "Rhodes the Port City" that is not top or central. Materials for Sophia Awakening recipe shown above.

In-game description:
A precious stone also known as a sunstone. It has the power of the sun inside and is said to bring revelation to people.
